description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the WPEFramework project, including type selection, function traits, type inheritance checks, and compile-time feature detection macros.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select type at a given index from a parameter pack.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract function traits such as return type, class type, and argument types from various function pointer types.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed or unsigned.

classes.name: inherits_checker
classes.description: Template struct used internally to check inheritance relationships between types.

classes.name: is_same
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same.

classes.name: inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if one type inherits from another.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if one type is the same as or inherits from another.

classes.name: HAS_MEMBER_NAME
classes.description: Macro to generate a trait to detect the presence of a member function with a specific name and signature.

classes.name: HAS_MEMBER
classes.description: Macro to generate a trait to detect the presence of a member function with a specific name and signature.

classes.name: HAS_STATIC_MEMBER
classes.description: Macro to generate a trait to detect the presence of a static member with a specific name.

classes.name: HAS_TEMPLATE_MEMBER
classes.description: Macro to generate a trait to detect the presence of a template member function.

classes.name: enable_if
classes.description: Template struct for SFINAE-based enable_if functionality.
